name: MPU-6886 6-axis IMU (accelerometer + gyroscope)
description: TDK InvenSense 6-axis motion sensor: 3-axis accelerometer (±2/4/8/16 g, 16384 LSB/g at ±2 g), 3-axis gyroscope (±250/500/1000/2000 °/s, 131 LSB/(°/s) at ±250 °/s) and a die temperature sensor (326.8 LSB/°C, 0 = 25 °C), I2C at 0x68. The chip runs on 1.71–3.45 V. Sold as: M5Stack Unit Mini IMU (U095, MPU6886) with a 4-pin HY2.0/Grove socket (GND, 5V, SDA, SCL), an HT7533 3.3 V regulator, BSS138 level shifters with 4.7 kΩ pull-ups on SDA/SCL to the supply pin, I2C address 0x68.
eli5: Feels tilt, shaking and turning on three axes, like the motion sensor in a phone.

pins.name: 5V
pins.description: Supply, 3.3–5 V (red wire); an HT7533 regulator feeds the chip 3.3 V. With a 3.3 V microcontroller, power it from 3.3 V so the SDA/SCL pull-ups go to 3.3 V

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (yellow wire); level-shifted, 4.7 kΩ pull-up to the supply pin on the module

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (white wire); level-shifted, 4.7 kΩ pull-up to the supply pin on the module

supplierQuery: M5Stack Unit Mini IMU MPU6886 U095
buildNotes: The module has a Grove/HY2.0 socket, not pins: use a Grove-to-Dupont cable (black GND, red 5V, yellow SDA, white SCL).
The SDA/SCL pull-ups (4.7 kΩ) go to whatever you feed the 5V pin. With an ESP32 or Pico (3.3 V logic) feed it 3.3 V; the regulator then passes about 3.2 V to the chip, inside its 1.71–3.45 V range.
WHO_AM_I (0x75) must read 0x19 (an MPU-6050 reads 0x68, an MPU-6500 0x70).
The chip powers up asleep (PWR_MGMT_1 = 0x41): write 0x80 to reset, wait 100 ms, then write 0x01 to wake it with the PLL clock; gyro data are valid about 35 ms later.

Read ACCEL_XOUT_H..GYRO_ZOUT_L (0x3B–0x48) in one 14-byte burst: seven big-endian signed words (accel X/Y/Z, temperature, gyro X/Y/Z). At ±2 g and ±250 °/s: 16384 LSB/g and 131 LSB/(°/s); temperature = raw / 326.8 + 25 °C.
Mount it flat and firmly: at rest Z reads about +1 g. Average a few hundred gyro readings at rest and subtract them as the offset.

driver.code:
# MPU-6886 6-axis IMU (TDK InvenSense), MicroPython driver for I2C.
# From the MPU-6886 datasheet (DS-000193 v1.1):
#   WHO_AM_I 0x75 = 0x19
#   PWR_MGMT_1 0x6B (bit 7 DEVICE_RESET, bit 6 SLEEP, CLKSEL[2:0]); reset value 0x41 (asleep)
#   CONFIG 0x1A (DLPF_CFG); SMPLRT_DIV 0x19; GYRO_CONFIG 0x1B (FS_SEL[4:3]);
#   ACCEL_CONFIG 0x1C (ACCEL_FS_SEL[4:3]); ACCEL_CONFIG2 0x1D (A_DLPF_CFG[2:0]); PWR_MGMT_2 0x6C
#   ACCEL_XOUT_H 0x3B .. GYRO_ZOUT_L 0x48: 7 big-endian two's-complement words
#   (accel X, Y, Z, temperature, gyro X, Y, Z)
#   Accel: 16384 / 8192 / 4096 / 2048 LSB/g for +-2/4/8/16 g
#   Gyro: 131 / 65.5 / 32.8 / 16.4 LSB/(deg/s) for +-250/500/1000/2000 dps
#   Temperature: TEMP_degC = TEMP_OUT / 326.8 + 25
import time

_SMPLRT_DIV = 0x19
_CONFIG = 0x1A
_GYRO_CONFIG = 0x1B
_ACCEL_CONFIG = 0x1C
_ACCEL_CONFIG2 = 0x1D
_ACCEL_XOUT_H = 0x3B
_PWR_MGMT_1 = 0x6B
_PWR_MGMT_2 = 0x6C
_WHO_AM_I = 0x75

_ACCEL_RANGES = {2: (0, 16384.0), 4: (1, 8192.0), 8: (2, 4096.0), 16: (3, 2048.0)}
_GYRO_RANGES = {250: (0, 131.0), 500: (1, 65.5), 1000: (2, 32.8), 2000: (3, 16.4)}


def _s16(hi, lo):
    v = (hi << 8) | lo
    return v - 65536 if v & 0x8000 else v


class MPU6886:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x68, accel_range=2, gyro_range=250):
        """addr: 0x68 with AD0 low (M5Stack Unit Mini IMU), 0x69 with AD0 high.
        accel_range: 2, 4, 8 or 16 g. gyro_range: 250, 500, 1000 or 2000 deg/s."""
        if accel_range not in _ACCEL_RANGES or gyro_range not in _GYRO_RANGES:
            raise ValueError('bad accel_range or gyro_range')
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        time.sleep_ms(100)  # allow the chip to finish power-up before register access
        who = self.i2c.readfrom_mem(addr, _WHO_AM_I, 1)[0]
        if who != 0x19:
            raise OSError('MPU-6886 not found (WHO_AM_I 0x%02X, expected 0x19): check wiring' % who)
        self._w(_PWR_MGMT_1, 0x80)   # DEVICE_RESET: restore default register values
        time.sleep_ms(100)
        self._w(_PWR_MGMT_1, 0x01)   # wake (SLEEP = 0), CLKSEL = 1: PLL if ready, else internal oscillator
        time.sleep_ms(10)
        self._w(_PWR_MGMT_2, 0x00)   # all accel and gyro axes on
        self._w(_CONFIG, 0x03)       # DLPF_CFG = 3: gyro 41 Hz bandwidth, 1 kHz internal rate
        self._w(_SMPLRT_DIV, 0x04)   # 1 kHz / (1 + 4) = 200 Hz output rate
        a_sel, self._a_lsb = _ACCEL_RANGES[accel_range]
        g_sel, self._g_lsb = _GYRO_RANGES[gyro_range]
        self._w(_GYRO_CONFIG, g_sel << 3)    # FS_SEL, FCHOICE_B = 00 (DLPF in use)
        self._w(_ACCEL_CONFIG, a_sel << 3)   # ACCEL_FS_SEL
        self._w(_ACCEL_CONFIG2, 0x03)        # ACCEL_FCHOICE_B = 0, A_DLPF_CFG = 3: 44.8 Hz bandwidth
        time.sleep_ms(50)  # gyro start-up time 35 ms typical

    def _w(self, reg, val):
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, reg, bytes([val]))

    def raw(self):
        """(ax, ay, az, temp, gx, gy, gz) raw counts from one 14-byte burst (same sample)."""
        d = self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, _ACCEL_XOUT_H, 14)
        return tuple(_s16(d[i], d[i + 1]) for i in range(0, 14, 2))

    def read(self):
        """((ax, ay, az) in g, (gx, gy, gz) in deg/s, chip temperature in deg C)."""
        r = self.raw()
        a = (r[0] / self._a_lsb, r[1] / self._a_lsb, r[2] / self._a_lsb)
        g = (r[4] / self._g_lsb, r[5] / self._g_lsb, r[6] / self._g_lsb)
        return a, g, r[3] / 326.8 + 25.0

    def acceleration(self):
        return self.read()[0]

    def gyro(self):
        return self.read()[1]

    def temperature(self):
        return self.read()[2]

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from mpu6886 import MPU6886

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
imu = MPU6886(i2c)
while True:
    (ax, ay, az), (gx, gy, gz), t = imu.read()
    print('A=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f g G=%.1f,%.1f,%.1f dps T=%.1fC' % (ax, ay, az, gx, gy, gz, t))
    time.sleep(1)
